name: ziwei-doushu
description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据
one_liner: An open-source engine, plus a huge dataset of pre-written readings, for generating traditional Chinese 'Zi Wei Dou Shu' astrology birth charts.
buyer: A Chinese-language app developer or online astrologer serving the fortune-telling and destiny-reading market who wants chart math and ready reading text without building either from scratch.
business_use_cases: A mobile app developer builds a paid birth-chart app for Chinese-speaking users, using this engine for the math and the dataset for ready-made reading text.
A content creator on Chinese social platforms sells personalized chart readings to followers, drafting scripts faster from the dataset.
A matchmaking or wellness app adds a paid 'destiny compatibility' feature powered by this engine.

money_ideas.idea: A polished consumer app charging per personalized chart reading (the project's own linked site already does this commercially).
A 'daily fortune' subscription app that auto-generates content with the engine.

steal_this: Wrap a simple web form ('enter your birth date and time') around the engine and sell single $5 PDF chart reports to the Chinese diaspora market this weekend.
